forma_de_gobierno.evidencia: All officers serve at most two consecutive weeks; any officer may be removed at any time by majority for abuse, incapacity, or failure to perform duties.

regla_de_decision.evidencia: Decision rule in force: simple majority (more votes in favor than against).

resolucion_de_disputas.evidencia: A dispute decision by majority must be recorded with reasons and cannot create new rules, impose penalties, or override these minutes.

castigo.evidencia: Violators must repair or compensate. Repeated violations are subject to penalty. A repeated violation is any second violation after a recorded warning.

conflicto_de_recursos_resuelto_por.evidencia: Renewable resources (fruit trees, timber, fresh water, animals) may be taken only at or below replacement rate. Non-renewable resources (coal, metals) may be extracted only after majority approval and only for survival, rescue, or essential tools, in the smallest amount necessary, with a conservation plan.

eje_colectivo_individual.evidencia: Non-renewable resources (coal, metals) may be extracted only after majority approval and only for survival, rescue, or essential tools, in the smallest amount necessary, with a conservation plan.
